title: Do you think this was the right call?  My full review: @Broadway Ben ...
transcript: Queen of Versailles just announced that it is coming to Broadway, but not this season. It is waiting a season and coming next season. And honestly, I think more shows should do this. I think there are so many shows, I just want to get to Broadway as quick as possible. They grab the first open theater and they rush to Broadway before they are ready. What inevitably happens is that these shows open to a lukewarm critical response, and then they close early, which is a shame, because most of these shows had so much potential. They just needed, like, another year of development to really fine tune the show. And if you've seen my full review of Queen of Versailles, you know, that's kind of how I felt about this show. I thought it was really good, but it needed a little bit of work before coming to Broadway. And I'm glad that they're taking that time to do the work. And then, of course, there is the added benefit here of not putting Kristen Chenoweth into a very crowded and competitive best leading actress in a musical category at the Tony's this year. So all in all, it is definitely a win win, and I'm really excited to see the changes that they make and to see the show when it eventually hits Broadway next season. Honestly, my biggest hope is that they just give Nina White better songs because she is so good and she deserves Better material than what she is given
classificationReason: Creator discusses news about the show's postponement to next season and references their previous review, but this video is primarily commentary about the timing decision rather than a review of the production itself
